about.title: Ku Saabsan The PLACE Online
about.heading: Ku soo dhowow PLACE Online
about.p1: The PLACE waa wax ka badan dhismo kaliya — waa xarun bulsho oo firfircoon oo loogu talagalay in la awood-siiyo, la isku xidho, oo lagor-baahiyo shaqsiyaadka deegaanka Amarillo. Si loo hubiyo in bulshadayadu ay heli karto taageero muhiim ah goor iyo meel walba ay u baahdo, waxaan ku ballaarinay gaadhitaankayaga adduunka dhijitaalka ah iyada oo loo marayo Barnaamijkayaga cusub ee Web-ka Horumarsan (PWA).
about.p2: Iyada oo loo marayo madasha tan, ilaha muhiimka ah, isku-xidhka bulshada iyo nidaamyada taageero ayaa hadda la heli karaa 24/7, meel kasta, iyaga oo jebinaya caqabadaha jirka oo kula kulmaya halkii aad joogtid.
about.collab.title: Waxaa ku awoodda iskaashi
about.collab.p: The PLACE wuxuu jiraa oo wuxuu kobcaa shukri u ah aragti la wadaago, maalgelin, iyo go'aan u ah seddex urur oo aan macaash-doon ahayn oo deegaanka ah. Iyaga oo wada jira, waxay isku daraan xoogagga gaarka ah si ay u abuuraan habdhis dhammaystiran oo taageero ah:
about.rlp.desc: Loogu talagalay in la caawiyo shaqsiyaadka ka soo jeeda bulshooyinka qaxootiga si ay u kobcaan. Iyagoo ka saaraya caqabadaha luqadda, sharfaya dhaxalka kala duwan ee dhaqanka, iyo kobcinta hoggaamiyeyaasha bulshada, waxay ka caawiyaan deriskayaga inay si kalsoon ula falgalaan dunida ku xeeran.
about.sm.desc: Wuxuu diiradda saaraa horumarinta xaafadda oo dhammeystiran oo hal-abuur leh. Iyagoo isticmaalaya qaab awood-siin ku saleysan oo ka qaybqaadasho bulsho, Square Mile wuxuu dhisaa shabakado ganacsato, ganacsiyo yaryar, iyo dadka deggan si ay u keenaan cusboonaysiin iyo soo-celin meelaha aan agabkooda lahayn.
about.wfil.desc: Urur awood-siiya iyada oo loo marayo fanka, adeegga, iyo bulshada. Waxay diiradda saaraan abuurista jawi waxbarasho oo iskaashi iyo hal-abuur leh kuwaas oo kobciya madaxbannaani oo ka caawiya deriska qaxootiga ah ee Texas Panhandle (iyo dibedda) inay riyaayadooda ku noolaadaan.
about.vision.title: Aragtidayada Dhijitaalka
about.vision.p1: Annagoo wadnaha jirka ah ee The PLACE keensanay meel dhijitaal ah oo 24/7 ah, waxaan ka dhigaynaa wax sii fudud kal hore in la helo ilaha luqadda, qalabka horumarinta bulshada, iyo fursadaha awood-siinta hal-abuurka.
about.vision.p2: Haddii aad ka soo gudbi doonto albaabbadayada jirka ama aad taabato shaashadda taleefankaaga, qof walba wuxuu mudan yahay PLACE.
about.notDo.title: Waxa aanan samaynayn
about.notDo.body: The PLACE Online ma beddelo talo sharci, caafimaad, dhaqaale, socdaal, ama dawladeed. Go'aamadaas, fadlan la hadal aqoonyahan u qalma ama ururka aad ku kalsoon tahay.
